title: There Is More to Refusal in Large Language Models than a Single Direction
abstract: arXiv:2602.02132v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior work argues that refusal in large language models is mediated by a single direction, enabling steering and abliteration. We show that this account is incomplete: across diverse refusal and non-compliance categories, refusal behaviors correspond to geometrically distinct directions in activation space. Yet activation steering along any refusal-related direction produces nearly identical refusal--over-refusal trade-offs, acting as a shared one-dimensional control knob. Thus, different directions primarily affect not whether the model refuses, but how it refuses. Using sparse autoencoders, we uncover a structured internal representation of refusal: a reusable core of shared refusal latents supplemented by style- and domain-specific latents. translated_title: 大语言模型中的拒答机制远不止一个方向
translated_abstract: 先前的研究认为，大语言模型中的拒答行为由单一方向介导，这使得激活引导和“消融越狱”成为可能。我们证明这一解释并不完整：在多样的拒答与不服从类别中，拒答行为对应于激活空间中几何上截然不同的多个方向。然而，沿任何拒答相关方向进行激活引导，都会产生几乎相同的“拒答—过度拒答”权衡，如同一个共享的一维控制旋钮。因此，不同的方向主要影响的不是模型是否拒答，而是模型如何拒答。借助稀疏自编码器，我们揭示了拒答的结构化内部表示：一个可复用的共享拒答潜在特征核心，辅以风格和领域特定的潜在特征。线性干预会将这种结构坍缩为统一的行为控制，抹平了不同拒答类型之间的机制差异。我们的结果调和了拒答引导表面上…（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文挑战了“大语言模型拒答由单一方向介导”的既有观点，发现拒答行为对应激活空间中多个几何上不同的方向，但这些方向如同共享的一维控制旋钮，主要影响模型“如何拒答”而非“是否拒答”。
en_tdlr: This paper challenges the view that refusal in LLMs is mediated by a single direction, showing that refusal behaviors correspond to multiple geometrically distinct directions in activation space, yet these directions act as a shared one-dimensional control knob that primarily affects how the model refuses rather than whether it refuses.
